frame: Part-local metres: +X starboard, +Y forward, +Z up. External face/rear/edge mounts extend along -Y from the hardpoint centre; top mounts extend +Z; interior items stand on the floor plane. Thrust acts along +Y. glTF export: (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y).
